gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam keeps its middle zone busy, with generous openings in the s that make each line feel friendly. And Tilt Neon's tube-like marker stroke gives the pair its bold, commanding punch up top.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Tilt Neon looks bent from a single wire, with a splayed c terminal and a big x-height. Noto Sans Mandaic follows in curvy, loose plain sans letters whose lowercase rises close to the capitals.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads with small letters standing nearly capital-sized, and its curves end in clear daylight. Tilt Neon's diagonals are as thick as its horizontals, so the sans below feels like a lighter echo.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nume: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals stands tall and slim. Under it, Tilt Neon's unvarying weight from word to word makes a firm, chunky header, while the plain sans body keeps its gaping c visible.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-medefaidri: Tilt Neon makes every diagonal as stout as every upright, with a splayed c terminal and a large x-height. Make it small and that weight crowds in.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: That splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon away at once. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek then adds large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, a sans-serif foil to the heading's solid tube.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-mende-kika: Chunky, stenciled and loud. Tilt Neon holds a constant weight like a cut channel, earning its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve below.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic reads openly, with c shapes you can see through and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Tilt Neon contributes the pair's strongest quality, a plain stitched-thread outline stroke that stays bold and commanding.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-modi: Tilt Neon looks drawn with a marker tip, its splayed c terminal and large x-height giving it a bold stance. Noto Sans Modi brings the pair's best quality, daylight inside every curve and lowercase close to capital height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so none bump together, and its tall lowercase looks sturdy. Noto Sans Mono would keep that sturdiness paragraph after paragraph, with Tilt Neon's thick-only outline still bold above.
